_comment: Provenance manifest for vendor-adapted code (house pattern: frontmatter_rag/VENDORED.json). This session declares the sources; the Opus build session MUST update each entry's adapted_into + divergence_notes + source_sha256 when it performs the vendor-adapt in Phase 1/3. Never hand-edit source files in their original location.

vendored.name: nai KGManager schema-profile + edge-weight core
divergence_notes_required: edge weight column becomes `confidence`; NULL confidence must raise MissingConfidence, never default to 1.0 (the original defaults to 1.0 — that behavior is the bug this framework exists to kill)
schema profiles become GraphSchema.profile declarations, not a hardcoded module-level dict

vendored.name: nai pure-numpy pagerank + cycle detection
divergence_notes_required: numpy becomes the [analytics] optional booster; the pure-python fallback MUST produce byte-identical ranked output (tests/test_numpy_absent_byte_identical.py)

vendored.name: nai weighted-path confidence composition (product; Dijkstra over -log(w))
divergence_notes_required: path confidence is reported as confidence_kind=path_product_score — a ranking score, NOT a calibrated probability (Double-Calibration, arXiv:2601.11956); the SoT forbids presenting it otherwise
